annotations.title: Read the rest of a result

description: The rest of an answer call cut to fit, or the whole result in another view or with other fields. Free: nothing is fetched again. Results are kept 24 hours and read with the key's account that made the call.

fields.description: Keep only these fields, by dotted path (author.name), to save tokens.

offset.description: Where to go on, as the cut notice printed it; 0 or left out: from the start.

view.description: How much of each object: compact leaves out empty fields, standard keeps them, full adds platform extras under ext. The call's own view when left out.

name: read_more
title: Read the rest of a result
